blocks.text: go to work, go home, go to the cinema

O'zbekchada «ishga boraman», «maktabga boraman», «kinoga boraman» — uchalasi bir xil tuzilgan. Inglizchada esa ular ikki guruhga bo'linadi. Ba'zi joylar **asosiy vazifasi uchun** tilga olinganda artiklsiz aytiladi: go to **work**, go to **school**, go to **bed**, go **home**. Boshqa joylar — kinoteatr, bank, vokzal — odatdagidek **the** bilan: go to **the** cinema, go to **the** bank. Bu darsda qaysi so'z qaysi guruhga kirishini va nega shunday ekanini ko'ramiz.
Artiklsiz: work, school, university, hospital, bed, home

Bu so'zlar artiklsiz kelganda bino emas, **faoliyat yoki holat** nazarda tutiladi. go to school — o'quvchi sifatida o'qishga borish; be in hospital — bemor sifatida davolanish; go to bed — uxlash. Bunda qaysi maktab yoki qaysi karavot ekani muhim emas — muhimi, nima qilinayotgani. O'zbekchada ham shunga o'xshash farq bor: «kasalxonaga tushdi» (bemor) va «kasalxonaga bordi» (ko'rgani); «maktabga chiqdi» (o'quvchi bo'ldi) va «maktabga bordi» (binoga).

rows: go to **work**, be at **work**, start / finish **work**
go to **school**, be at **school**, start / leave **school**
go to **hospital**, be in **hospital**, come out of **hospital**
go to **bed**, be in **bed**, get out of **bed**

blocks.text: **home** bilan harakat fe'llaridan keyin **to** ham, artikl ham qo'yilmaydi: go **home**, come **home**, get **home**, arrive **home**, on the way **home**. «go to home» — eng ko'p uchraydigan xato. Joy aytganda esa — **at home**: be at home, stay at home, work from home. O'zbekchadagi «uyga» (jo'nalish) va «uyda» (o'rin) farqi inglizchada **home** va **at home** bo'lib chiqadi.

Agar gap binoning o'zi haqida bo'lsa yoki u yerga **boshqa maqsadda** borilsa — **the** kerak. Ota-ona o'qituvchi bilan gaplashgani maktabga boradi — go to **the** school (o'qish uchun emas). Bemorni ko'rgani boramiz — at **the** hospital. Karavot ustidagi narsa — on **the** bed (uxlash emas, mebel).

rows: His father went to **the school** to meet the teacher.

blocks.text: the bilan: the cinema, the bank, the doctor

Shahardagi boshqa joylar odatdagi qoida bo'yicha **the** bilan aytiladi (69-dars): shaharda hamma biladigan yoki o'zingiz doim boradigan joy. Odamlar ham shunday: go to **the** doctor, go to **the** dentist — o'zbekchada «shifokorga borish», «tish shifokoriga borish». Britaniyada ko'pincha `'s` bilan: at **the doctor's**, at **the hairdresser's** (= shifokor xonasida, sartaroshxonada).

Transport turi **by** bilan aytilganda ham artikl yo'q: **by bus**, **by car**, **by train**, **by plane**, **by taxi**, **by bike**, **by metro**. Piyoda — **on foot**. Lekin aniq transport tilga olinsa, artikl yoki egalik so'zi qaytadi: **in my car**, **on the 8 o'clock train**. O'zbekchadagi «avtobusda», «poyezdda» shu **by** ga to'g'ri keladi. Predloglar batafsil — 111-dars.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «go to home», «go to the home» → **go home**; «I'm at the work» → **I'm at work**; «go to the bed» → **go to bed**; «go to cinema» → **go to the cinema**; «go to doctor» → **go to the doctor**; «by the bus», «with bus» → **by bus**; «My son is at the school» (o'quvchi sifatida) → **My son is at school**.

Eslab qolish: «ish, o'qish, davolanish, uyqu, uy» — faoliyat, artikl yo'q (work, school, university, hospital, bed, home). «Biror xizmat yoki ko'ngilochar joy» — **the** (the cinema, the bank, the station, the doctor).

British va American English farqi: Britaniyada **in hospital**, **at university**; Amerikada ko'pincha **in the hospital**, **in college**. Bu kitob British English bo'yicha. Masjid haqida ikkala variant ham uchraydi: go to **mosque** / go to **the mosque**.

examples.title: **go to work**, **be at work**
examples.description: **work** — ish joyi ma'nosida artiklsiz: go to **work**, be at **work**, start / finish **work**, after **work**, on the way to **work**.

sentences.text: What time do you usually **go to work**?
sentences.translation: Odatda soat nechada **ishga borasiz**?

sentences.text: Aziz isn't here — he's **at work**.
sentences.translation: Aziz bu yerda emas — u **ishda**.

sentences.text: I **start work** at eight and **finish work** at five.
sentences.translation: **Ishni** soat sakkizda **boshlab**, beshda **tugataman**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza usually walks **to work**, because her office is near.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza odatda **ishga** piyoda boradi, chunki ofisi yaqin.

sentences.text: Every morning my father **leaves for work** at seven.
sentences.translation: Otam har kuni ertalab soat yettida **ishga jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: Were you **at work** yesterday? — No, I was ill.
sentences.translation: Kecha **ishda** edingizmi? — Yo'q, kasal edim.

sentences.text: Sarah often stays late **at work**, so she gets very tired.
sentences.translation: Sara ko'pincha **ishda** kech qoladi, shuning uchun juda charchaydi.

sentences.text: After **work** we sometimes go to a café together.
sentences.translation: **Ishdan** keyin ba'zan birga kafega boramiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod had an accident on the way **to work**, but he's OK.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **ishga** ketayotganda avariyaga uchradi, lekin u yaxshi.

sentences.text: When I **got to work** this morning, my boss was waiting for me.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab **ishga yetib kelganimda**, boshlig'im meni kutib turgan ekan.

examples.title: **go to school**, **at university**
examples.description: O'qish joylari — o'quvchi yoki talaba sifatida — artiklsiz: go to **school**, be at **school**, start / leave **school**, at **university**, at **college**.

sentences.text: My little brother **goes to school** by bus.
sentences.translation: Ukam **maktabga** avtobusda boradi.

sentences.text: The children are **at school** until two o'clock.
sentences.translation: Bolalar soat ikkigacha **maktabda**.

sentences.text: Madina is nineteen, and she's **at university** in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Madina o'n to'qqiz yoshda, Toshkentda **universitetda o'qiydi**.

sentences.text: What did you learn **at school** today?
sentences.translation: Bugun **maktabda** nima o'rganding?

sentences.text: James **left school** at sixteen and started working.
sentences.translation: Jeyms o'n olti yoshida **maktabni tugatib**, ishlay boshladi.

sentences.text: Do you want to **go to university** after school? — Yes, I want to study medicine.
sentences.translation: Maktabdan keyin **universitetga kirmoqchimisan**? — Ha, tibbiyotni o'qimoqchiman.

sentences.text: Our son **started school** last September.
sentences.translation: O'g'limiz o'tgan sentyabrda **maktabga chiqdi**.

sentences.text: Emma was ill, so she didn't **go to school** on Monday.
sentences.translation: Emma kasal edi, shuning uchun dushanba kuni **maktabga bormadi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod is studying engineering **at college** in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Bekzod Manchesterda **kollejda** muhandislik bo'yicha o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: When I was **at school**, I hated maths, but now I teach it!
sentences.translation: **Maktabda o'qiganimda** matematikani yomon ko'rardim, hozir esa o'zim shu fandan dars beraman!

examples.title: **go home**, **at home** — no **to**!
examples.description: **home** harakat fe'llari bilan — **to** siz va artiklsiz: go **home**, come **home**, get **home**, arrive **home**. Joy — **at home**, stay **at home**, work from **home**.

sentences.text: It's nearly midnight — I really must **go home** now.
sentences.translation: Soat o'n ikki bo'lay deb qoldi — endi rostdan **uyga** ketishim kerak.

sentences.text: Is Madina **at home**? — No, she's at work.
sentences.translation: Madina **uydami**? — Yo'q, ishda.

sentences.text: What time did you **get home** last night?
sentences.translation: Kecha soat nechada **uyga yetib kelding**?

sentences.text: I'm tired, so I'm going to **stay at home** this evening.
sentences.translation: Charchadim, shuning uchun bu kecha **uyda qolaman**.

sentences.text: Dad usually **comes home** at about seven.
sentences.translation: Dadam odatda soat yettilarda **uyga keladi**.

sentences.text: Tom **works from home** three days a week.
sentences.translation: Tom haftasiga uch kun **uydan ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: On the way **home** we stopped at the bakery.
sentences.translation: **Uyga** qaytayotib novvoyxonaga kirdik.

sentences.text: Aziz **left home** at eighteen and moved to Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Aziz o'n sakkiz yoshida **ota-ona uyidan chiqib**, Toshkentga ko'chib ketdi.

sentences.text: Nobody was **at home** when the postman came, so he left a note.
sentences.translation: Pochtachi kelganda **uyda** hech kim yo'q edi, shuning uchun u xat qoldirib ketdi.

sentences.text: Don't forget to text me when you **arrive home**.
sentences.translation: **Uyga yetib borganingda** menga xabar yozishni unutma.

examples.title: **go to bed**, **in bed**, **in hospital**
examples.description: Uyqu va davolanish — artiklsiz: go to **bed**, be in **bed**, get out of **bed**; go to **hospital**, be in **hospital**, come out of **hospital** (British English).

sentences.text: I usually **go to bed** at about eleven.
sentences.translation: Odatda soat o'n birlarda **uxlashga yotaman**.

sentences.text: Are you still **in bed**? It's ten o'clock!
sentences.translation: Hali ham **yotibsanmi**? Soat o'n bo'ldi!

sentences.text: The children **went to bed** early because they were tired after the trip.
sentences.translation: Bolalar safardan charchagani uchun erta **uxlashga yotishdi**.

sentences.text: My uncle is **in hospital** with a broken leg.
sentences.translation: Amakim oyog'i singani uchun **kasalxonada yotibdi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod had a bad accident and **went to hospital** in an ambulance.
sentences.translation: Bekzod jiddiy avariyaga uchradi va tez yordam mashinasida **kasalxonaga tushdi**.

sentences.text: On Sundays Sarah likes to stay **in bed** until ten.
sentences.translation: Yakshanba kunlari Sara soat o'ngacha **to'shakda yotishni** yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Madina was **in hospital** for a week after the operation.
sentences.translation: Madina operatsiyadan keyin bir hafta **kasalxonada yotdi**.

sentences.text: Don't read **in bed** — it's bad for your eyes!
sentences.translation: **Yotib** kitob o'qima — ko'zingga zarar!

sentences.text: What time did you **get out of bed** this morning?
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab soat nechada **o'rningdan turding**?

sentences.text: When Grandpa **came out of hospital**, the whole family had a big dinner.
sentences.translation: Bobom **kasalxonadan chiqqanida**, butun oila katta ziyofat qildi.

examples.title: **school** or **the school**? Purpose or building
examples.description: Asosiy maqsadda — artiklsiz (o'quvchi, bemor, uyqu); binoning o'zi yoki boshqa maqsad — **the**: go to **the school** to meet the teacher, visit someone at **the hospital**.

sentences.text: Aziz **goes to school** — he's in Year 7.
sentences.translation: Aziz **maktabda o'qiydi** — u 7-sinfda.

sentences.text: Yesterday his mum went to **the school** to talk to his teacher.
sentences.translation: Kecha onasi o'qituvchisi bilan gaplashish uchun **maktabga** bordi.

sentences.text: Grandpa is **in hospital**, and we visit him at **the hospital** every evening.
sentences.translation: Bobom **kasalxonada yotibdi**, biz uni har kuni kechqurun **kasalxonaga** borib ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza works as a nurse at **the hospital** near the park.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza park yaqinidagi **kasalxonada** hamshira bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Good night, everyone — I'm **going to bed**.
sentences.translation: Hammaga xayrli tun — men **uxlagani yotaman**.

sentences.text: Your jacket is on **the bed** in my room.
sentences.translation: Kurtkangiz xonamdagi **karavot** ustida.

sentences.text: Sarah's brother is **at university** in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Saraning akasi Oksfordda **universitetda o'qiydi**.

sentences.text: There's a free concert at **the university** on Saturday evening.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni kechqurun **universitetda** bepul konsert bor.

sentences.text: Tom's grandmother **goes to church** every Sunday, and she knows everyone there.
sentences.translation: Tomning buvisi har yakshanba **cherkovga** boradi, u yerda hammani taniydi.

sentences.text: The tourists visited **the church** in the old town because of its beautiful windows.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar eski shahardagi **cherkovni** chiroyli derazalari uchun borib ko'rishdi.

examples.title: **the cinema**, **the bank**, **the doctor**
examples.description: Shahardagi xizmat va ko'ngilochar joylar, shuningdek shifokor, tish shifokori, sartarosh — **the** bilan: go to **the** cinema, at **the** dentist's.

sentences.text: Shall we **go to the cinema** tonight?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **kinoga** boramizmi?

sentences.text: I need to **go to the bank** before it closes.
sentences.translation: Yopilishidan oldin **bankka** borishim kerak.

sentences.text: You've got a temperature — you should **go to the doctor**.
sentences.translation: Isitmangiz bor — **shifokorga** borishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Madina is **at the dentist's** — she's got toothache.
sentences.translation: Madina **tish shifokorida** — tishi og'riyapti.

sentences.text: How do I get to **the airport** from the city centre?
sentences.translation: Shahar markazidan **aeroportga** qanday borsam bo'ladi?

sentences.text: Tom went to **the post office** to send a parcel to his sister.
sentences.translation: Tom singlisiga posilka jo'natish uchun **pochtaga** bordi.

sentences.text: We met Aziz **at the station** by chance.
sentences.translation: Azizni **vokzalda** tasodifan uchratib qoldik.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **goes to the gym** before work, at half past six.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza ishdan oldin, soat oltiyarimda **sport zaliga** boradi.

sentences.text: I'm going to **the hairdresser's** on Friday — I need a new look.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni **sartaroshga** boraman — menga yangi ko'rinish kerak.

sentences.text: Aziz had to **go to the police station** because somebody stole his car.
sentences.translation: Mashinasini o'g'irlab ketishgani uchun Aziz **politsiya bo'limiga** borishi kerak bo'ldi.

examples.title: **by bus**, **by train**, **on foot**
examples.description: Transport turi — **by** + artiklsiz: by bus, by car, by plane, by taxi, by metro, by bike; piyoda — **on foot**. Aniq transport bo'lsa — in Aziz's car, the 8 o'clock train.

sentences.text: I usually go to work **by bus**.
sentences.translation: Odatda ishga **avtobusda** boraman.

sentences.text: Is it quicker to go **by train** or **by car**?
sentences.translation: **Poyezdda** borgan tezroqmi yoki **mashinada**mi?

sentences.text: Bekzod came to the party **on foot** because he lives nearby.
sentences.translation: Bekzod yaqin yashagani uchun ziyofatga **piyoda** keldi.

sentences.text: We travelled from London to Edinburgh **by coach** — it was cheap but slow.
sentences.translation: Londondan Edinburgga **shaharlararo avtobusda** bordik — arzon, lekin sekin edi.

sentences.text: Sarah never goes anywhere **by plane** — she's afraid of flying.
sentences.translation: Sara hech qayerga **samolyotda** bormaydi — uchishdan qo'rqadi.

sentences.text: It's only ten minutes from here **by taxi**.
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan **taksida** atigi o'n daqiqa.

sentences.text: Dilnoza goes to university **by metro**, and it takes twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza universitetga **metroda** boradi, yigirma daqiqa ketadi.

sentences.text: Did you come **by bike**? — Yes, it's a lovely day for cycling.
sentences.translation: **Velosipedda** keldingmi? — Ha, velosiped haydash uchun ajoyib kun.

sentences.text: We went to Samarkand **by train**, but we came back **in Aziz's car**.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga **poyezdda** bordik, lekin **Azizning mashinasida** qaytdik.

sentences.text: Tom missed **the 8 o'clock train**, so he had to go to Oxford **by bus**.
sentences.translation: Tom **soat sakkizdagi poyezdga** ulgurmadi, shuning uchun Oksfordga **avtobusda** borishga majbur bo'ldi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a busy day
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: artiklsiz iboralar (home, at work, at school, in hospital, by metro) va **the** bilan joylar (the bank, the dentist, the cinema).

sentences.text: — Hi, Madina! Are you going **home**?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Madina! **Uyga** ketyapsanmi?

sentences.text: — Not yet. First I have to go to **the bank** and **the post office**.
sentences.translation: — Hali emas. Avval **bankka** va **pochtaga** borishim kerak.

sentences.text: — Are you **at work** tomorrow?
sentences.translation: — Ertaga **ishdamisan**?

sentences.text: — No, I'm taking my son to **the dentist** in the morning.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, ertalab o'g'limni **tish shifokoriga** olib boraman.

sentences.text: — Isn't he **at school** on Fridays?
sentences.translation: — Juma kunlari u **maktabda** emasmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, but he'll **go to school** after lunch.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin u tushlikdan keyin **maktabga** boradi.

sentences.text: — And how's your father? Is he still **in hospital**?
sentences.translation: — Otang qalay? Hali ham **kasalxonada**mi?

sentences.text: — No, he **came home** on Monday, thank God.
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, xudoga shukur, dushanba kuni **uyga qaytdi**.

sentences.text: — That's great! Shall we **go to the cinema** at the weekend?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Dam olish kunlari **kinoga** boramizmi?

sentences.text: — Good idea! Let's go **by metro** — parking in the centre is terrible.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr! **Metroda** boraylik — markazda mashina qo'yish juda qiyin.
